sn56.17:1.1: bhikkhu- -nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Avijjā avijjā ti bhante vuccati || || Katamā nu kho bhante avijjā kittāvatā ca avijjāgato hotī ti || || Yaṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhe aññāṇam dukkhasamudaye aññāṇam dukkhanirodhe aññāṇaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminiyā paṭipadāya aññāṇaṃ ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhu avijjā ettāvatā ca avijjāgato hotī ti || ||
sn56.17:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhu Idam dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pe || || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || || Atha
